description: A tall silver-and-blue water bottle sits upright on a wooden table in front of you. The left hand reaches in from the left to steady the bottle as a left-hand object, while the right hand moves in from the right to grip the black cap as a right-hand object and twists it counterclockwise; the cap comes off and the right hand sets it down on the tabletop to the bottle’s right while the left hand keeps the bottle upright.
